== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "The calm before the storm. Wild Card players, 161 for Star Wars CCG and 61 for Star Trek CCG, will soon fill the room." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Wild Card players, 161 for Star Wars CCG and 61 for Star Trek CCG, will soon fill the room."
